articles.title: La 'cesión' de entradas, el bitcoin de La Rosaleda
articles.standfirst: Tener una localidad es un lujo en el estadio malaguista
articles.summary: Tener una localidad es un lujo en el estadio malaguista
articles.body: El abono del Málaga CF se ha convertido en un bien especialmente cotizado. Basta con darse una vuelta por determinados foros y redes sociales vinculados al malaguismo para comprobarlo. “Tengo dos entradas juntas para el domingo”, “cedo dos localidades en Fondo Norte” o “dos abonos disponibles en Preferencia” son mensajes cada vez más habituales cuando se acerca un partido en La Rosaleda. La situación no es nueva y recuerda a la vivida la pasada temporada. Muchos aficionados que decidieron renovar su carnet después del descenso de 2023 no podían imaginar entonces que, pocos años después, conseguir un abono del Málaga se convertiría en una misión complicada. Ahora, quienes sí disponen de uno cuentan con una localidad que tiene una demanda considerable. Esa circunstancia ha provocado que algunos abonados opten por una fórmula paralela para recuperar parte del dinero cuando no pueden acudir a un encuentro. Oficialmente se habla de “cesión”, ya que la venta de un abono o de una entrada por encima de los cauces establecidos está prohibida tanto por la normativa del club como por la legislación vigente. Sin embargo, en la práctica, muchos anuncios esconden operaciones de compraventa entre particulares. El Málaga dispone de su propio sistema para estos casos. El abonado que sabe que no podrá asistir puede poner su localidad a disposición del club para que vuelva a salir a la venta. Si finalmente otro aficionado compra esa entrada, el titular recibe el 40% del importe, que se convierte en saldo para descontar en la renovación del siguiente abono. Esa compensación, además, está limitada al 50% del precio del carnet actual. Si la localidad no encuentra comprador, no existe compensación económica. El problema es que la alternativa informal resulta más atractiva para algunos abonados. Una venta directa permite recuperar una cantidad mayor y de forma inmediata, mientras que el mecanismo oficial depende de que la entrada sea revendida y la compensación se recibe como saldo para el futuro. Así, las redes sociales se han convertido en un escaparate habitual para este tipo de operaciones. La situación también tiene una explicación desde el punto de vista del club. La Rosaleda continúa registrando grandes entradas y el Málaga mantiene una de las afluencias más destacadas de la categoría. Mientras las localidades que quedan libres terminan ocupándose, la existencia de este mercado paralelo no parece haberse convertido en una prioridad. Eso no significa que detrás de cada anuncio exista necesariamente una operación de reventa. Habrá abonados que, simplemente, no puedan acudir a un partido y busquen a otro malaguista que aproveche su asiento. Pero la proliferación de estos mensajes apunta a una realidad cada vez más evidente: lo que nació como una solución puntual para no perder una entrada se está convirtiendo, en determinados casos, en una fórmula habitual de reventa encubierta.

articles.title: 'If I were Vinicius, I would have forced an exit from club': Real Madrid coach drops bombshell
articles.summary: Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho said on Saturday that he would have forced an exit from the club last summer if he were in Vinicius Junior's position,
articles.body: Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho said on Saturday that he would have forced an exit from the club last summer if he were in Vinicius Junior's position, pointing to the repeated abuse the Brazilian winger has faced.Vinicius was sent off during Madrid's win over Villarreal last weekend for pulling an opponent's hair. He received a four-match ban as a result and will miss the Clasico against Barcelona on October 25.The 26-year-old has also been regularly targeted by opposition fans and subjected to racial abuse on several occasions since joining Madrid in 2018."He's a spectacular kid who it's easy to have a good relationship with," Mourinho told reporters."He's a fantastic boy, tremendous credit to him for the fact that he keeps living and surviving and still having a smile..."If it were me in his place, probably I wouldn't be here. In this last summer I would have forced an exit to a league, a country, to somewhere there are rival clubs and stadiums that respect him."Vinicius signed a new contract with Madrid in the summer, extending his stay at the club until 2032.Questions remain over whether Madrid can fit their attacking stars Vinicius, Kylian Mbappe and Jude Bellingham into the same team without losing balance."Because he loves Real Madrid, for loving the club and the city, for believing that things can always improve, he renewed and he keeps on smiling," continued Mourinho."No one or nobody can... well, influence him negatively yes, because he's human... but take away his joy of living and working and being with his team-mates, no, no one can do that."Mourinho substituted Vinicius during Madrid's 4-3 Champions League win at Roma on Wednesday. The winger is still trying to regain the form that helped him win the competition twice under former coach Carlo Ancelotti.Mourinho also said he was pleased that Vinicius had received a four-match ban, as he had expected the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee to impose a longer suspension."I thought some hidden figures at the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee would give him one or two more," Mourinho said.Madrid will face Sevilla on Sunday as they look to avoid falling further behind La Liga leaders Barcelona, who visit Real Betis later on Saturday.Barcelona, coached by Hansi Flick, have won every match this season and are six points ahead of fourth-placed MadridStay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.body: Quique Sánchez Flores compareció en sala de prensa para analizar la visita de su equipo a Balaidos, un lugar donde estrenó su casillero de victorias la pasada temporada como técnico del Alavés con una espectacular remontada. El técnico madrileño confía en lograr un buen resultado que permita a los suyos cortar la dinámica negativa en la que se han visto tras cuatro jornadas sin ganar. 4 jornadas sin ganar: "Tenemos el ánimo y la predisposición de ir a cada partido con la idea de hacerlo bien y puntuar. No hay urgencia. Partimos de una posición en la que luchamos por la quinta plaza si tenemos un buen resultado. Lo que hicimos en el inicio fue extraordinario ahora compensa este momento que sabíamos que podía pasar porque es una Liga muy expuesta". Baja de Ángel Pérez: "Estamos viendo las opciones. Le damos vueltas desde el primer día de entrenamiento. Tomaremos una decisión relativamente pronto y dependerá del partido que imaginemos". 3-4 en Balaidos: "Fue un momento muy bonito y especial para el equipo por la rebeldía de los futbolistas ante la situación. Quedarse con ese espíritu está muy bien, pero va a ser un partido completamente diferente. Seguramente será muy exigente. Jugamos contra el equipo menos goleado de la categoría, que ha equilibrado su defensa con el ataque y que sigue siendo peligroso". Plano ofensivo: "Me interesa que sigamos transitando como lo hacíamos en los primeros partidos porque somos capaces de generar espacios a mucha velocidad. Tenemos que hacer una lectura de las situaciones, entender las posiciones que ocupamos en ataque, la ocupación de los espacios...". Dinámica negativa: "No somos un equipo que esté jugando para tener un punto de los últimos doce posibles. Contra el Atlético y el Valencia hicimos partidos muy buenos en los que pudimos puntuar. Cuando ganamos los partidos de tres en tres tampoco éramos magníficos. Ni ahora estamos tan deprimidos ni antes estábamos tan felices". Celta: "Me niego a pensar que hay partidos de una Liga y otros de otra. Todos son importantes y a todos hay que ir con la mentalidad de hacer las cosas bien. Somos conscientes de que podemos ganar, perder o empatar cada partido. Hay que ser inconformistas, de que vamos a sumar el máximo de puntos posibles, pero sin olvidar la dificultad que nos vamos a encontrar. La riqueza del Alavés hasta ahora es que hemos competido cada partido". Miguel Rodríguez: "Le vamos a ayudar porque es un jugador muy válido y que con sus condiciones nos va a ayudar. Ha venido en unas condiciones distintas a las que estaba en el grupo. Se tuvo que poner bien físicamente, entender a lo que jugamos, la ocupación de los espacios, cómo defiende el equipo... Va pasando pantallas y está más cerca. Nuestro valor es que todos los jugadores valgan lo que valían al inicio y alguno que valgan más".

articles.title: Chiefs C Creed Humphrey addresses the errant late-game snap in Week 4

articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs center Creed Humphrey spoke with reporters Friday about the errant late-game snap in Week 4 against the Las Vegas Raiders and his communication with Patrick Mahomes under center or in shotgun.

"Usually, Pat (Patrick Mahomes) will let us know if it's under center or shotgun," said Humphrey. "So, yeah, we try to clarify it every time."

Humphrey has had some errant snaps this season, including a notable mishap late in the fourth quarter of Week 4. Mahomes tried to regroup and nearly turned the ball over.

"It's just focusing on it, focusing in those situations. You know, late game, last game, things like that," said Humphrey. "So something that needs to stop now. So yeah, just remaining focused throughout the entire game. So just making sure that snap first every time."

Humphrey has an overall Pro Football Focus grade of 73.2 through the first 4 games this season. A multiple-time All-Pro since joining the league, Humphrey still has parts of his game he's working to improve as he gains more experience.

articles.title: Barcelona revive interest in 18-year-old Benfica wonderkid amid competition from Newcastle and Manchester United
articles.summary: Barcelona have renewed their interest in Benfica right-back Daniel Banjaqui, with the 18-year-old emerging as a potential long-term defensive target ahead of...
articles.body:
Barcelona have renewed their interest in Benfica right-back Daniel Banjaqui, with the 18-year-old emerging as a potential long-term defensive target ahead of next summer's transfer window.

According to SPORT , the Catalan club has returned to monitoring the Portuguese youngster after tracking his breakthrough at Benfica last season.

As expected, though, the pursuit will not fall short of any competition, with Newcastle United and Manchester United also gathering information on the defender.

Notably, Barcelona's interest does not necessarily signal an imminent bid.

This is because Benfica have secured Banjaqui's future until 2031 with an €80 million release clause, while the club's asking price and Hansi Flick's existing defensive options could complicate any move.

Benfica set high valuation for Barcelona target Daniel Banjaqui

Barcelona were already interested in Banjaqui during his emergence at Benfica, but the Portuguese club moved to protect one of their promising young players with a long-term contract and a substantial release clause.

Daniel Banjaqui is back on Barcelona's radar. (Picture credit: Instagram/@_dbanjaqui_)

At this moment, there are reports stating that Benfica could be willing to negotiate from around €35 million to €40 million.

That figure could rise towards €50 million depending on Banjaqui's performances throughout the season, although his limited first-team experience remains a factor in his current valuation.

The 18-year-old has made six appearances for Benfica's senior team, accumulating 416 minutes.

While those opportunities have helped the 18-year-old establish himself at the highest level, he still has considerable room to develop before commanding the kind of fee Benfica could eventually seek.

At the same time, Barcelona are not the only club keeping tabs on his progress. Newcastle and Manchester United are also assessing the right-back's situation ahead of a potential summer move.

Eric Garcia and Kounde complicate Barcelona's plans

Daniel Banjaqui is also wanted by Newcastle United and Manchester United. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

Despite renewing their interest, Barcelona must weigh the potential benefits of signing Banjaqui against the options already available to Flick.

As such, Eric Garcia's growing importance and Jules Kounde's presence at right-back give the manager alternatives in the position.

Flick is said to be satisfied with Garcia's development and believes Kounde can rediscover his best form and compete for the starting role despite the fact that he is attracting interest from the Premier League .

That situation makes a major investment in another right-back less urgent.

Barcelona may see Banjaqui as a player with significant long-term potential, but committing €35 million to €40 million to a teenager with limited senior experience would represent a substantial decision.

Napoli look to Lorenzo Lucca, Scott McTominay and Giovane amid an injury crisis, while Venezia make their debut under new coach Davide Nicola.

It kicks off at the Stadio Pierluigi Penzo at 14.00 UK time (15.00 CEST).

This has been a rough few days for both these clubs, as Napoli suffered yet more injuries and a 3-1 Champions League loss to Villarreal , while Venezia fired Giovanni Stroppa after losing all six Serie A matches.

David Neres joined Antonio Vergara, Costantino Favasuli and Alessandro Buongiorno on the treatment table, with Alisson Santos, Mathias Olivera and Frank Zambo Anguissa only fit for the bench.

With exhaustion piling up from that midweek Champions League defeat, Rasmus Hojlund and Kevin De Bruyne are rested in favour of Lucca and Giovane, moving McTominay into a more advanced role.

Venezia debut under new coach Nicola , having lost all six Serie A matches so far this season with Stroppa.

They have a lengthy absentee list too, including Armel Bella-Kotchap, Marin Sverko, Bartol Franjic, Thierry Correia and Andrea Adorante, while former Napoli man Pasquale Mazzocchi is not fully fit either.

Juan Jesus comes face to face with his former club already.

Akor Adams and John Yeboah lead the attack, but the problems are in defence, conceding 16 goals in seven games.

In five matches in the state championship, Atlético have recorded three wins, one draw and one defeat, scoring 20 goals and conceding five. In the last round, the Vingadoras faced Cruzeiro in a match that ended 4–3, with two goals from Pimenta and one from Bárbara Melo.

On Wednesday (October 14), the Vingadoras drew 1–1 with Internacional at Beira-Rio in Porto Alegre in the first leg of the quarterfinals. Giovanna Barraca scored Atlético's goal. A place in the semifinals for the first time will be decided next Tuesday (October 20) at Arena MRV.
